subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should normal `sync` change from replacement semantics to merge-by-default, with users required to choose `--restore` for replacement?
rationale: This is a user-visible archive-retention and upgrade-policy decision; tests can verify either implementation but cannot choose the permanent default for existing users.

options.title: Keep replacement default
options.body: Retain the established replacement behavior for `sync` and expose retention as an explicit merge mode.

options.title: Approve merge default
options.body: Adopt merge-by-default as the new archive contract and require explicit upgrade documentation and real proof for merge and restore behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep replacement default
recommendation.body: Retain the established replacement behavior for `sync` and expose retention as an explicit merge mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author has the clearest supplied evidence of ownership of the proposed archive and sync contract, though current-main history ownership remains low confidence.
